metadata.title: Scenora | Realistic Chat Simulator & Conversation Storytelling Platform
metadata.description: Create realistic WhatsApp, Telegram, Instagram, Snapchat, and iMessage conversations. Customize messages, participants, timing, and interactions to build engaging marketing content with Scenora.
metadata.keywords: chat simulator, whatsapp simulator, telegram simulator, instagram dm simulator, snapchat simulator, imessage simulator, conversation creator, message simulator, fake chat generator, marketing content creator, storytelling platform, chat scenario builder, screen recording tool

home.title: A clean base before building any large product
home.description: This template prepares architecture, rules, performance, localization, and user experience without linking to a store or any specific backend workflow.
home.pointOne: App Router and Server Components first
home.pointThree: SEO and accessibility rules from day one
home.pointFour: HTTP layer prepared without real endpoints
home.architectureBody: Each domain owns its feature, while app only handles routing and composition.
home.performanceBody: The template defines rules for images, fonts, caching, and JavaScript reduction.
home.qualityBody: Every page should pass build, lint, typecheck, and Lighthouse review.

auth.placeholder: This is a structural placeholder only. Do not wire authentication or backend logic before the real project phase starts.

studio.appSubtitle: Build a realistic chat, play it, and export a video
studio.autosavedHint: Your draft is saved automatically in this browser
studio.samsungMessagesNote: On Samsung, iMessage is shown as Samsung Messages, the phone's built-in messaging app.
studio.statusBarHint: Choose which icons appear at the top of the phone
studio.name: Name
studio.empty: No messages yet. Add the first one.
studio.emptyBody: Pick who is talking below and type the first message, or start with a quick one:
studio.composerHint: Enter to add · Shift+Enter for a new line
studio.typingHint: How long the typing indicator shows first
studio.autoZoomHint: The camera glides to each new message during playback and export
studio.recordHint: Clean stage ready for screen recording
studio.recordKeys: H hides the controls · Esc exits
studio.importFailed: That file isn't a valid scenario
studio.clearConfirmBody: This removes your draft and every saved project from this browser. It can't be undone.
studio.shortcutsHint: Work faster without leaving the keyboard
studio.exportSaveHint: On mobile, choose Save to Files from the share sheet.
studio.exportUnsupported: Your browser can't generate video. Use Chrome or Edge, or use Recording Mode and capture your screen.
studio.exportHint: The video is generated entirely in your browser — nothing is uploaded.
studio.replyMissing: The quoted message no longer exists
studio.replyLater: The quoted message now comes after this one
studio.replyFirstHint: The first message can't quote an earlier one
studio.autoTimingHint: Smart timing: set every pause and typing time from message length
studio.autoTimingDone: Natural timing applied to every message
studio.composeDurHint: How long my text takes to type before it's sent. 0 = automatic from its length
studio.composeTyping: Type my messages in the composer
studio.composeTypingHint: During playback and export, my text appears letter by letter in the input field, then the send button is tapped.
studio.templatesHint: Ready-made marketing chats. Pick one, then make it yours.
studio.transcriptHint: Paste a script or a WhatsApp chat export. Senders and times are detected for you.
studio.transcriptPlaceholder:
Me: Hi there!
Khalid: Hello 👋

[10:41] Khalid: Is the offer still on?
10/18/26, 10:42 - Me: Yes, until Friday
studio.transcriptFormats: One message per line: “Name: text”, “[10:41] Name: text” or WhatsApp export lines.
studio.transcriptClipboardDenied: Clipboard access was blocked. Paste with Ctrl+V instead.
studio.transcriptNothing: No messages found yet. Start each line with a name and a colon, e.g. “Khalid: Hello”.
studio.transcriptManyNames: Everyone else is shown as the other person.
studio.transcriptUseNames: Use these names for the participants
studio.projectsHint: Save several chats in this browser and switch between them.
studio.projectSaveAs: Save the current chat as a new project
studio.projectsEmptyHint: Save this chat above. Projects keep updating automatically while you edit them.
studio.projectsPrivacy: Projects stay in this browser only. Nothing is uploaded.
studio.projectAutosaveHint: Every change is saved to this project in your browser
studio.storageFullHint: Delete old projects or use smaller images, then save again.
studio.shareHint: Anyone who opens the link gets an editable copy of this chat.
studio.shareCopyFailed: Couldn't copy. The link is selected, copy it with Ctrl+C.
studio.shareLong: very long links may be cut by some apps
studio.shareImagesDropped: {count} image(s) were left out to keep the link short. Photos and profile pictures aren't included.
studio.sharePrivacy: Nothing is uploaded: the chat is stored inside the link itself (after #), which browsers never send to a server.
studio.sharedInvalid: That share link is broken or incomplete
